title: Citi upgrades US equities to Overweight from Neutral on a quality and defensive tilt, citing elevated war uncertainty | Newsquawk
text: Upgrades Global Materials to Overweight from Neutral Downgrades Global Communication Services to Underweight. Emerging Market Equities to Neutral from Overweight on vulnerability to energy shocks and a stronger USD. What it means Citi's upgrade of US equities to Overweight suggests a strategic shift towards quality and defensiveness, driven by rising war-related uncertainties. This move indicates that they see potential resilience in the US markets, while their downgrades reflect concerns over sectors vulnerable to external shocks, particularly in emerging markets and communications. The implications could point to a defensive positioning in portfolios amid prevailing geopolitical tensions. What our latest note said US Market Open , 9 Nov, 11:25 UTC · what it led with US President Trump said it is highly unlikely the US will need to resume military action against Iran if negotiations progress, while Secretary of State Rubio said talks have been unproductive.
